title: 第3章  心如铁石百炼金刚第4章  武道印记燃钢之心
slug: 从龙象般若功开始创武成圣
content_zh:
“来吧，打死我，我爸真是副校，正在台上看着呢，我看你敢不敢打死我！”
青石浇筑，浑然一体，不怕被打坏的擂台上。
一位快要被铁甲战士打坏了的学员，坚持不退，强撑着报出后台。
而高台上，那位刘副校闻言拍案而起，怒发冲冠。
“逆子，我没你这个儿子，我今天就打死你！”
说罢，他作势就要下台。
一旁的老师们连忙拉着劝。
“老刘，别这样，你这样我害怕！”
“儿子没用，养着玩就是，还真指望他有出息不成？”
“真打死他，你家婆娘那虎狼掌你可受不起！”
看着乱糟糟的局面，李三全摆手一按，止住台上的闹剧，沉声对下面的副校之子道：
“刘旺，你修为虽然差了些火候，但能坚持到现在，武道意志也算坚定，勉强达到了我院入院条件。
但你记住，你能入院，是靠你自身的本事，跟你副校之子的身份可没关系！”
这话说的，在场就没一个人能信。
刘副校跟众老师习以为常，都是一个班子共事的，谁家没个倒霉孩子，废物亲戚的？
睁一只眼闭一只眼，大家互相走走后门，也算是他们作为老师的福利了。
要是连这点福利都没，以他们的本事，还当什么老师？
去那星海淘金，去那魔域寻宝，哪怕去地下城打怪兽，也比老师挣得多啊！
学员们对此行径却鄙之视之。
因为他们可没副校爹，真就只能玩命。

嘭！
苏青瞳孔一缩，看着一个体魄比铁牛还壮，得称铁象的魁梧学员，被那铁拳战士舞动如风车般的铁臂，横扫至墙壁上。
墙壁上留下一个人形血印，栽倒在地的铁象兄也被早就准备好的急救人员抬到板板上带走。
嘭！
又一声巨响。
苏青身子一抖，看到一个娇俏玲珑，可爱呆萌的眼镜娘，被那铁甲战士无情的捏住头颅举在空中，摔在地上。
这位眼镜娘他可认识。
是第一高中有名的走位怪，以身法灵活，操作细腻著称。
铁牛这样的，跟她斗上三天三夜，也摸不到她的裙角。
可刚才跟这铁甲战士只是斗上五六十招，就突然立足不稳，身子一歪，被这铁甲战士抓住了破绽。
嘭！
第三声巨响传来。
苏青不由自主的往后退了一退。
content_en:
"Come on, beat me to death. My dad is really the vice principal. He is watching from the stage. Let me see if you dare to beat me to death!"
Made of bluestone, it is seamless and not afraid of being damaged in the ring.
A student who was about to be beaten by an armored soldier refused to retreat and forced himself to report out of the backstage.
On the high platform, Vice-Colonel Liu heard this and stood up, furious.
"You traitor, if I don't have a son like you, I will beat you to death today!"
Having said that, he pretended to step down.
The teachers on the side quickly tried to persuade him.
"Lao Liu, don't be like this, I'm scared if you do this!"
"My son is useless. I just keep him for fun. Do you really expect him to be successful?"
"If you really beat him to death, you won't be able to withstand your mother-in-law's claws!"
Looking at the messy situation, Li Sanquan waved his hand to stop the farce on the stage, and said in a deep voice to the son of the vice principal below:
"Liu Wang, although your cultivation level is a little behind, you have been able to persist until now, and your martial arts will is still strong, and you have barely met the requirements for admission to our hospital.
But remember, your admission to the hospital is based on your own ability, and it has nothing to do with your status as the son of the vice-principal! "
No one here could believe what he said.
Vice-principal Liu and the teachers were accustomed to working together in the same team. Whose family didn't have an unlucky child, a relative of a good-for-nothing?
Turning a blind eye and letting everyone go through each other's back door can be considered a benefit for them as teachers.
If they don't even have this benefit, how can they be teachers with their abilities?
Go to the Star Sea to pan for gold, go to the Demon Realm to hunt for treasures, even go to the dungeon to fight monsters, you can still earn more than the teacher!
The students despised this behavior.
Because they don't have a deputy principal, they really have no choice but to risk their lives.
Bang!
Su Qing's pupils shrank as he watched a burly student, who was stronger than an iron bull and was called an iron elephant, being swept up against the wall by the iron fist warrior's iron arm that danced like a windmill.
A human-shaped blood mark was left on the wall, and Brother Tiexiang, who had fallen to the ground, was carried to the board and taken away by the emergency personnel who had been prepared.
Bang!
Another loud bang.
Su Qing shuddered and saw a pretty, cute and bespectacled girl, whose head was ruthlessly held by the armored warrior, lifted up in the air, and fell to the ground.
He knows this girl with glasses.
He is a famous position-walking monster in First High School, known for his flexible movement and delicate operation.
Tieniu was like this, even if he fought with her for three days and three nights, he still couldn't touch the hem of her skirt.
But just now, I had just fought fifty or sixty moves with this armored warrior, and suddenly I lost my footing. I tilted my body, and this armored warrior caught the flaw.
Bang!
A third loud noise came.
Su Qing stepped back involuntarily.
